Your roster at a glance

Provisional · Week 2 optimal lineup · 10.00 projected points · 1/1 slots · #1 of 2 comparable teams (2 total).

Current position: Standing #1 of 2 by Sleeper record/PF. Provisional · Week 2 projected optimal lineup: 10.00 points; 1/1 slots covered; #1 among 2 comparable teams; 2 of 2 league teams comparable. This compares analytical lineups, not submitted Sleeper starters or overall franchise quality. Availability is uncertain for named rostered players; numerical scenarios are provisional, not verified active cover.

Main strength: Provisional positional strength: QB. Strength is not automatically expendable depth.

Depth and uncertainty: Replacement cover is provisional: availability or projection freshness is not fully verified. Review Depth before moving reserves.

Future flexibility: 3 owned picks, including 1 first-round pick (2028). Multi-season sustainability is not established.

Your goal: REBUILD: review exact future capital before exchanging it for short-term production.

DTOS shows lineup strength, depth, Market value and future outlook separately. It does not yet calculate a validated overall team grade.
Standings ranked by Sleeper record, then Points For.
3/3 picks have compatible Market prices. Original-franchise identities and current ownership are listed in Draft capital; unknown pick ranges remain unknown. Reported ages cover 1/1 optimal starters (31–31). Ages and current projections do not establish years remaining or a multi-season forecast.
Statistical record/PF standing is separate from official playoff qualification and final seeding.
Projection coverage: 3/3 rostered players. This counts player-week numbers, including reserve/taxi players; it is separate from playable starting-slot eligibility. Submitted starters remain separate from the optimal legal lineup.
Current strength is not championship probability or future sustainability.
Some current-week evidence is not fully verified; findings are provisional, not a fresh team verdict. Source and availability limitations follow.
Availability is uncertain for named rostered players; numerical scenarios are provisional, not verified active cover.
Current-week diagnostic; future projections, byes and long-term quality are not inferred.
Removal/addition effects are separate scenarios and must not be summed.
Reserve support is a disjoint legal assignment, not an injury probability or guaranteed replacement.
Lineup comparison: 2/2 franchises can fill the configured starting slots with supported eligible projections. Incomplete bench coverage alone does not exclude a franchise; this is separate from official standings and full replacement-depth support.
Prepared Team Strength covers 1/1 current weeks; complete-horizon points: 10. Other prepared horizons are projections, not a multi-season sustainability forecast.
QB reserve projections: 2/2; best supported eligible reserve 6 points. See Depth for legal, separate replacement scenarios; one player cannot cover simultaneous absences.
